checks.name: Direct clip seek evaluates actual numeric pose without crossed callbacks
Repeated backwards seeks remain exact and invalid requests preserve the existing transport
Stopping a direct preview leaves unrelated transports and current pose under session ownership
Timeline frameRate quantizes playhead while preserving fractional advancement
Timeline emits every crossed occurrence over multiple loops
Timeline samples assigned animation asset with local offset and rate
Repeated additive and partial layers do not accumulate the previous output
Rotation limits remain authoritative after inverse kinematics
Retargeting an unchanged rest pose preserves the target rest transform
Non-looping audio does not restart after the media element ends
Explicit stop remains stopped for an autoplay source
Shared clock is deterministic at supported sample rates across fixed-step partitions
Rig hierarchy survives source reorder and cyclic input is rejected
Rig zero-weight limits remain inert and copy constraints cannot break final hard limits
Invalid skin triangles are dropped as groups without shifting subsequent indices
Timeline paused seeks sample envelopes without accumulating previous output
Overlapping timeline audio voices retain independent rate/offset and release at clip end
Global pause suspends timeline voices even without another timeline evaluation
Subtitles disappear at the exact half-open clip end and paused seek restores text
Step keys switch at interior boundaries and Auto tangents use adjacent slopes
Key reduction preserves piecewise easing rather than deleting a meaningful middle key
Explicit root-motion extraction covers multiple and reverse loops without absolute teleport
Root-motion Ignore preserves scale tracks and loop cycle offsets wrap samples
Looping animator reaches its exit-time-one transition
Bus automation holds its end unless an explicit loop duration is set
Nested events survive crossing an entire clip and follow offset/rate ordering
Repeated nested instances create distinct voices using multiplied rate and owner play state
Branch consumes remaining time from its marker and suppresses events in skipped span
Reverse timeline dispatch order follows traversal and explicit seek dispatches nothing
Zero-weight layers keep advancing and triggers are consumed after every layer evaluates
Transition interruption uses the active transition policy rather than unrelated inbound edges
Regular source and polyphonic clocks follow scaled transport, manual pause, seek and trim end
Unused sources do not consume voice budgets or duck buses and UI voices obey bus/mute limits
Solo nested bus keeps its ancestors audible and unrelated sibling silent
Audio dispose releases every source and UI reference and clears transport diagnostics
Missing animation tracks crossfade against the underlying pose
Timeline overlap weights normalize jointly and additive unit scale remains neutral
Timeline sprite frames restore the pre-animation sprite when the clip is no longer active
Slicing preserves interpolated boundaries and curved interior values with declared precision
Retiming preserves curve values, rescales sprite frames, events, markers and command tracks
Every numeric track and command kind survives normalize/JSON/reload and dispatches in time order
Root-motion preview refuses unbounded sample expansion before allocating it
Runtime recording captures frame zero and every integer frame across coarser simulation updates
Rig skin deformation preserves mirrored bind geometry and follows translated root pose
Timeline track kinds and every clip field survive normalization and JSON reopen
Mixer routing, effects, snapshots, ducking, automation and device settings survive JSON reopen
Cyclic and excessive timeline traversal pauses with retained diagnostics and no partial commands
Mixer sends cannot close feedback through parent buses declared later
Visibility tracks seek back to the underlying state and cannot stop their own playhead
